commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to 34% and benchmark indices suffering institutional liquidation following the surprise RBI repo rate hike and geopolitical crude spikes, the broader market sits in an O'Neil market correction. Stan Weinstein's core doctrine warns against aggressive positioning when major indices breach key intermediate moving averages, as three out of four stocks track the general tape. Jesse Livermore emphasized sitting tight when the macro wind is against you. Even with high-confidence breakout patterns emerging in select names, Minervini's progressive exposure dictates strict risk management: preserve capital, demand pristine CANSLIM fundamentals, keep position sizes defensive, and defer aggressive capital allocation until a confirmed follow-through day.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Trading above key daily moving averages and testing 20-session pivot at 109.09 on 2x average volume. However, the base lacks structural tightening and relative strength is fragile.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severely fails CANSLIM criteria. Top-line contracted 56.3% YoY in Q1 FY27, with net margins under 3% and poor historical ROE below 4%. Not backed by institutional sponsorship.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Fails on a breakdown below the 100.37 stop; cut immediately to protect capital against severe operational underperformance.

ADANIGREEN.technical: Cleared 20-session high at 1633.13 on 4.16x volume with RSI at 62. Price maintains alignment above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 in a sustained Stage 2 advance.
ADANIGREEN.fundamental: Revenues grew 16.6% YoY with high 90% operating margins, but net profit growth slowed to 18.5%. Highly leveraged capital structure (debt-to-equity >5x) and low ROCE (~7.4%) limit leadership quality.
ADANIGREEN.risk: Breach below 1552.30 invalidates the breakout; honor strict stop discipline given heavy distribution in broader market.

ADFFOODS.technical: Forming a constructive double-bottom base with price above key averages and RSI at 71. Volume expansion of 1.67x supports the push toward the 322.27 trigger.
ADFFOODS.fundamental: Solid sales expansion of 25.9% YoY backed by pristine debt-free balance sheet, 24% ROCE, and stable 18% OPM, but EPS growth decelerated below the CANSLIM 25% threshold to 13.5%.
ADFFOODS.risk: Violation of the 302.23 swing low breaks technical support, requiring immediate risk curtailment.

AEGISLOG.technical: Powerful double-bottom base clearing 1530.23 on 1.74x volume. Moving average stack is aligned bullishly above a rising 30-week line, exhibiting textbook Stage 2 momentum and relative strength.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM fundamentals: Q1 FY27 EPS surged 268.9% YoY alongside 37.1% sales growth. Operating margins expanded to 30.3% on record liquids and gas terminal throughput, underpinned by healthy ROCE.
AEGISLOG.risk: A drop below the 1386.46 pivot low invalidates the base structure; execute strict Minervini risk containment.

AEROFLEX.technical: Double bottom showing lower-wick price rejection and neckline pressure toward 584.73. MACD and moving average stack reflect strong accumulation above rising short- and long-term averages.
AEROFLEX.fundamental: Phenomenal growth meeting CANSLIM standards: Q1 net profit climbed 162.1% YoY with revenue surging 72.4%. Margins held steady at 23%, debt remains negligible, and ROCE is robust near 19%.
AEROFLEX.risk: Thesis fails if price penetrates the 535.29 swing low; exit instantly without second-guessing.

AETHER.technical: Consolidating tightly within 1.5% of the 1815.91 pivot with RSI at 71. MACD above zero confirms constructive price absorption above 21 EMA and 50 SMA.
AETHER.fundamental: Rebounding performance with Q1 FY27 EPS accelerating to 28% YoY on 27.3% sales growth. Sustained operating margins at 31% and low debt are constructive, though prior-quarter EPS trailed CANSLIM benchmarks.
AETHER.risk: A break below the 1688.21 support level negates pattern integrity; apply mandatory stop discipline.
